name: Hayami Koto
source:
She has this mysterious air around her, like a bona fide Goth girl. Hayami wears skull and cross accessories. She likes to speak of death nonchalantly but she fears it the most after a tragic event that made her look at life in a different way - a secret that she keeps from the group.

[From [url=http://exogenesisvn.com/characters/]the official website[/url]]
